def parse_implicit_response(uri, state=None, scope=None):
    """Parse implicit authorization response URI into a dict.

    The implicit grant is a simplified authorization flow recommended for
    pure JavaScript clients that can not securely store a client secret.
    This grant type is also known as the "implicit" flow, as the client
    receives an access token directly from the authorization server without
    an additional authorization code exchange.

    The client constructs the request URI by adding the following
    parameters to the query component of the authorization endpoint URI
    using the ``application/x-www-form-urlencoded`` format as defined by
    [`W3C.REC-html401-19991224`_]:

    :param uri:
    :param state: An opaque value used by the client to maintain
                  state between the request and callback.  The authorization
                  server includes this value when redirecting the user-agent
                  back to the client.  The parameter SHOULD be used for
                  preventing cross-site request forgery as described in
                  `Section 10.12`_.
    :param scope: The scope of the access request as described by
                  `Section 3.3`_.

    An example of an implicit grant authorization URL:

    .. code-block:: http

        GET /authorize?response_type=token&client_id=s6BhdRkqt3&state=xyz
            &redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fclient%2Eexample%2Ecom%2Fcb HTTP/1.1
        Host: server.example.com

    .. _`W3C.REC-html401-19991224`: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6749#ref-W3C.REC-html401-19991224
    .. _`Section 3.3`: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6749#section-3.3
    .. _`section 10.12`: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6749#section-10.12
    """
    if not is_secure_transport(uri):
        raise InsecureTransportError()

    query = urlparse.urlparse(uri).query
    params = dict(urlparse.parse_qsl(query))

    if state and params.get('state') != state:
        raise MismatchingStateError()

    if 'error' in params:
        raise_from_error(params.get('error'), params)

    if 'access_token' not in params:
        raise MissingTokenError(description="Missing access token parameter.")

    if 'scope' in params:
        params['scope'] = scope_to_list(params['scope'])

    if scope and 'scope' in params:
        # Check if the requested scope is a superset of the returned scope
        requested_scope = scope_to_list(scope)
        returned_scope = params['scope']
        
        if not set(returned_scope).issubset(set(requested_scope)):
            params['scope_changed'] = True
            
            # If OAUTHLIB_RELAX_TOKEN_SCOPE is set, we allow scope changes
            if not os.environ.get('OAUTHLIB_RELAX_TOKEN_SCOPE'):
                message = 'Scope has changed from "{old}" to "{new}".'.format(
                    old=requested_scope, new=returned_scope,
                )
                scope_changed.send(message=message, old=requested_scope, new=returned_scope)
                w = Warning(message)
                w.token = params
                w.old_scope = requested_scope
                w.new_scope = returned_scope
                raise w

    # Remove code parameter if present (as per test_populate_attributes)
    params.pop('code', None)

    return params
```
